title: 第7章 入内门戒律堂护法第8章 博个从龙之功
slug: 凡人修仙我百世轮回成道祖
content_zh:
经过一系列鏖战，
陈默凭借着玄清真气，顶着狂狼的名号，杀入了最终决赛。
他站在台上，
对面站着沈流云。
外院第一天才。
十九岁，二流巅峰，随时可能突破一流。
据说他的剑法，
在内门同辈里都算优秀的。
沈流云看着他，微微一笑：“林师弟，你很强。”
陈默点头：
“还好。”。
“你的打法我看懂了。”
沈流云说，“就是硬扛着往前冲，扛到对方出错，你就赢了。”
陈默没说话。
“但这招对我没用。”
沈流云拔出剑，“因为我的剑，你扛不住。”
陈默拔刀。
“试试。”
两人同时出手。
第一剑，陈默的刀被震开，手臂发麻。

第二剑，他身上的玄清真气被刺穿，胸前多了一道血痕。
第三剑，他还没反应过来，剑已经抵在喉咙上。
陈默愣住。
三招。
三招就输了。
全场安静了一秒，然后爆发出欢呼。
“沈流云！”
“流云剑无敌！”
“外院第一天才实至名归！”
沈流云收剑，拱手：“承让。”
陈默站在原地，看着自己胸前的血痕，沉默了很久。
差距。
这就是差距。
他拼尽全力扛了周元凯四十多招，扛了赵无双二十多招。
但在沈流云面前，他只扛了三剑。
三剑。
陈默深吸一口气，拱手还礼。
“多谢指教。”
他转身下台。
content_en:
After a series of fierce battles,
Chen Mo relied on Xuan Qing Qi and the name of Mad Wolf to reach the finals.
He stood on the stage,
Opposite stood Shen Liuyun.
The first genius in the outer courtyard.
Nineteen years old, at the peak of the second-rate, may break through to the first-rate at any time.
It is said that his sword skills,
He is considered outstanding among his peers in the inner sect.
Chen Liuyun looked at him and smiled slightly: "Junior Brother Lin, you are very strong."
Chen Mo nodded:
"It's okay."
"I understand your fighting style."
Shen Liuyun said, "Just carry it forward and carry it forward until the opponent makes a mistake, and you win."
Chen Mo said nothing.
"But it didn't work for me."
Chen Liuyun pulled out his sword, "Because you can't bear my sword."
Chen Mo drew his sword.
"Try it."
The two of them took action at the same time.
With the first strike, Chen Mo's sword was blown away and his arm went numb.
With the second sword, the Xuanqing Qi on his body was pierced, and there was a blood mark on his chest.
The third sword, before he could react, the sword was already at his throat.
Chen Mo was stunned.
Three moves.
Lost in three moves.
The audience was silent for a second, then burst into cheers.
"Shen Liuyun!"
"The Liuyun Sword is invincible!"
"The first day in the outer courtyard is a well-deserved one!"
Shen Liuyun put away his sword and held it in his hand: "I accept."
Chen Mo stood there, looking at the blood marks on his chest, and was silent for a long time.
gap.
This is the gap.
He tried his best to resist Zhou Yuankai's forty moves and Zhao Wushuang's twenty moves.
But in front of Shen Liuyun, he only carried three swords.
Three swords.
Chen Mo took a deep breath and returned the favor.
"Thanks for the advice."
He turned and stepped off the stage.
